title: API surface
what: The published API and types of a client package, not the bytes.

title: Binary codecs
what: A binary document or value codec: BSON, msgpack, CBOR, protobuf, Avro, Arrow, ABI, DNS records.

title: JSON over HTTP
what: JSON over HTTP: GraphQL over HTTP, JSON-RPC over HTTP, PostgREST, REST APIs.

title: JSON over a socket
what: JSON over a socket: graphql-transport-ws, JSON-RPC over WebSocket and IPC, Phoenix, Pusher, SignalR JSON, Socket.IO events.

title: Length-prefixed envelopes
what: Frames with a binary length prefix: gRPC-web, Connect, MQTT remaining length, Avro RPC, AWS event streams, Arrow IPC, DNS over TCP.

title: Package files
what: The manifest, the published files and the test suite of a package, not the bytes on the wire.

title: Socket lifecycle
what: The connect, close, reconnect and event API of any stateful client (WebSocket, EventSource, WebTransport, long polling).

title: Text documents
what: A text document format that a client parses: XML, Extended JSON, .proto source, m3u8.

title: Text frames with headers
what: Text frames with a command, header lines and a body or separator: STOMP, SockJS, Engine.IO, Socket.IO, SSE, HLS playlists.

title: URLs and headers
what: The URL, the query string and the headers that a client writes from values of the app.
